_comment: Example managed-settings.json for organization rollout (pinning this template's project settings as org policy).
Managed settings outrank user / project / local settings and cannot be overridden by individuals.
Claude Code does not read this file itself (reference only). Copy only the keys you need and replace the values.
Draft auto mode trusted infrastructure (autoMode.environment) with /auto-mode-setup and transcribe it here.

sandbox.credentials is required: there is no built-in credential deny list, so ~/.aws and ~/.ssh are readable by default. failIfUnavailable / allowUnsandboxedCommands follow the official org-wide recommendation.
claudeMd: Every completion report must include the verification command's result (pass/fail counts). Never force-push.
companyAnnouncements: This repository runs on the project-blueprint harness. See .claude/guardrails.md for the guardrails.
